title: 4521-ESP-ANC-68-61-SS12
summary: This document outlines the engineering standards and specifications for a demineralized water piping system with 316 SS pipe, fittings, and valves. It includes details on construction materials, welding methods, flanges, bolting, gaskets, and various types of valves.
